title: HMW DNA Extraction for Long Read Sequencing Using CTAB
author: Benoît Vacherie
materials: Gently resuspend with the pipette the DNA pellet with 9.5 ml of G2 buffer (QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G). Buffer G2 Qiagen Catalog #1014636
Equilibrate a QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G column with 4 ml of QBT buffer . Genomic tip 100G Qiagen Catalog #10223 Buffer QBT Qiagen Catalog #19054
Put the column on a 15 ml tube.
Preheat 5 ml of QF buffer to 55°C. Buffer QF Qiagen Catalog #19056
QC results obtained on different species.

steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make 20 mL extraction buffer per 1 g leaf in a 50 mL tube containing final concentrations: 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, 20 mM EDTA, 2 % CTAB, 1.4 M NaCl, 1 % PEG 8000, and water to 20 mL.

steps.title: Add 2‑Mercaptoethanol and preheat
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 2‑Mercaptoethanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #M6250) to the 20 mL extraction buffer and preheat the mixture to 65 °C for approximately 15 min.

steps.title: Cool mortar with liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place mortar and pestle in liquid nitrogen and cool until bubbling stops.

steps.title: Grind tissue and transfer
steps.instruction: Grind 1 g frozen leaf tissue in the cooled mortar to a fine powder (~2 min) without adding liquid nitrogen, then transfer the powder to the pre‑warmed extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Grind tissue for ~2 min to fine powder.
Transfer powder to the pre‑warmed buffer.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹, Qiagen, Cat #19101) and vortex the tube for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate with agitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 1 h at 65 °C with intermittent agitation (300 rpm, 10 min intervals) using an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C (Cat #2231000667).

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to cool for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume (20 mL) chloroform, vortex twice for 5 seconds each.

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5500 × g, 4 °C for 10 min with low acceleration and deceleration (6/3).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Gently transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 volume isopropanol to the aqueous phase and invert the tube gently 10 times.

steps.title: Cold incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at –80 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Handle DNA medusa (if present)
steps.instruction: If a DNA medusa forms, recover it with a Pasteur pipette (tip intact), wash three times with 70 % ethanol, resuspend in 100 µL 1× TE, incubate 1 h at 55 °C, then store at 4 °C. Continue the protocol with the remaining solution if no medusa is observed.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5500 × g, 4 °C for 30 min with low acceleration/deceleration (6/3).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet; turn the tube upside‑down on a paper towel to remove residual liquid, ensuring the pellet remains attached.

steps.title: Incubate pellet
steps.instruction: Incubate the pellet for 15 min at 50 °C (the sample may be stored overnight at 4 °C at this point).

steps.title: Drain QBT buffer
steps.instruction: Allow all QBT buffer to drain by gravity into a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Add the sample in 9.5 mL G2 buffer onto the column and let it enter the resin by gravity flow.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with 7.5 mL QC buffer each (Qiagen, Cat #19055).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA with 5 mL QF buffer preheated to 55 °C (Qiagen, Cat #19056).

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation of eluate
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 volume isopropanol to the eluate and invert gently 20 times.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5500 × g, 4 °C for 30 min with low acceleration/deceleration (6/3).

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and gently resuspend the pellet in 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Transfer to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the resuspended DNA to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Eppendorf, Cat #022431021).

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min with low acceleration/deceleration (6/3).

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for ~10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50–100 µL 1× TE buffer.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension for 2 h at 55 °C or overnight at room temperature to ensure complete dissolution.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA at 4 °C.

steps.title: Quantify and assess quality
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA with a Qubit HS assay, check purity with a Nanodrop (260/280 and 260/230 ratios), and estimate fragment size using a Tapestation, Femto‑pulse, or Pippin Pulse.

steps.title: Optional size selection
steps.instruction: If required, deplete short fragments using an appropriate SRE size‑selection kit (XS, S, or XL) based on DNA concentration and length profile.
